experience.headline: Data operations backed by software and QA experience.

items.text: Own reporting for sales, marketing, operations, and leadership while supporting a migration from legacy systems to Salesforce. Rebuild SQL-driven audience automations in iPost Enterprise using Salesforce as the new data source, replace recurring manual work with repeatable processes, and handle report development, validation, testing, troubleshooting, configuration, formulas, and documentation.
Built SQL and Python tools, ETL workflows, internal automation, data-transfer processes, and user-facing applications that made operational work more repeatable and maintainable.

Advanced from volunteer contributor to paid development support through consistent, reliable work. Tested releases, reproduced defects, validated workflows and data, and documented actionable findings for developers.
